vibe_rationale: Federated national-circuit surf contest at a world-class wave; a genuine surf core, but a sport fixture with little culture programming of its own.
fit_notes: Competitive surfers from under 12 to open divisions and the surf-week crowd; active, but junior-heavy and mixed-age. A presenting bank and several partners are listed, but there is no partnership page or contact. A low-cost way into Pichilemu surf week, best bundled with Surfestival rather than bought alone. Activation would need a Chilean partner.
